cards.title: Position vector addition
cards.prompt:
Square infographic for a Chinese AI education article about absolute position encoding.

MAIN VISUAL: Two rows side by side, showing the same word "猫" at two different positions.

Top row: A colored block labeled "猫" (representing the word embedding vector x_猫, in warm orange) on the left. A plus sign "+". Another colored block labeled "位置 1" (representing the position vector p₁, in cool blue) on the right. An equals sign "=". A combined block on the far right showing the merged orange+blue result, labeled "h₁ = x_猫 + p₁".

Bottom row: Same layout. "猫" block (same orange, same size) + "位置 7" block (different blue pattern — the position vector is different) = a different combined orange+blue block, labeled "h₇ = x_猫 + p₇".

A small annotation below: "同一个词，不同位置 → 不同的输入向量".

VISIBLE TEXT: Chinese labels only — "猫", "位置 1", "位置 7", formula labels "h₁ = x_猫 + p₁" and "h₇ = x_猫 + p₇", annotation below. No English text, no title, no model names, no dates.

STYLE: Clean editorial science infographic, flat-vector style, light warm background, warm orange for word vectors, cool blue for position vectors, dark ink lines. Simple block diagram layout. No realistic people, no logos, no gradients, no dense content.

All visible text must be Chinese.

cards.title: Sinusoidal encoding waves
cards.prompt:
Square infographic for a Chinese AI education article about sinusoidal position encoding.

MAIN VISUAL: Three sine/cosine wave pairs, stacked vertically, each pair representing a different frequency (dimension pair) of the positional encoding.

Top pair (高频 / high frequency): Rapidly oscillating sine wave in warm red, cosine wave in dotted warm orange, cycling many times across the left-to-right axis. Label: "高频 → 分清相邻位置".

Middle pair (中频 / medium frequency): Moderately oscillating sine wave in green, cosine wave in dotted light green, cycling fewer times. Label: "中频 → 区分中距离".

Bottom pair (低频 / low frequency): Slowly oscillating sine wave in blue, cosine wave in dotted light blue, barely completing one cycle. Label: "低频 → 覆盖长距离".

On the right side of each pair, show a small clock-face visual: a clock with a rotating hand — fast-spinning second hand for high freq, medium-speed minute hand for mid freq, slow hour hand for low freq. This reinforces the "钟表" (clock) metaphor from the article.

VISIBLE TEXT: Chinese labels only — the three frequency labels as above, "位置 (pos) →" on the horizontal axis. No English text, no title, no model names, no dates.

STYLE: Clean editorial science infographic, flat-vector style, light warm background, distinct colors for each frequency pair, dark ink lines for axes. Generous vertical spacing between the three pairs. No realistic people, no logos, no gradients, no dense content.

All visible text must be Chinese.
